decided.default-case: a switch over a closed set names every member and has no default (EF-14)
decided.func-names: a callback is named by the binding or the call that holds it
decided.import/group-exports: each declaration is exported where it is declared
decided.import/no-cycle: dependency-cruiser's no-circular decides cycles, and this rule costs a second module-graph pass
decided.jsdoc/require-param-type: a doc comment never restates the compiler's type
decided.jsdoc/require-returns-type: a doc comment never restates the compiler's type
decided.jsdoc/require-throws-type: a doc comment never restates the compiler's type
decided.no-await-in-loop: a loop of awaits runs its steps in order on purpose
decided.no-magic-numbers: the ast-grep rule magic-number names every number but -1, 0 and 1 and keeps SC-11's unit forms, which this rule reports (063)
decided.no-redeclare: an Effect schema and its type share one name
decided.promise/prefer-await-to-callbacks: it flags every `(error) =>` handler a callback API takes, such as a decode's failure
decided.promise/prefer-await-to-then: it flags `Effect.catch` and the two-handler `.then` that DO-03 gives an outbound call
decided.promise/valid-params: it counts the two arguments of a data-first `Effect.catch(self, handler)` as a promise's, and the compiler checks each promise method's arguments
decided.sort-keys: key order is the schema's encode order, the /v1 field order and reference.json's order
decided.typescript/consistent-return: a switch names every member of its closed set and has no default, which the compiler checks with noImplicitReturns
decided.typescript/non-nullable-type-assertion-s: it asks for `!`, which TD-07 bans
decided.typescript/parameter-properties: erasableSyntaxOnly makes a parameter property a compile error
decided.typescript/prefer-nullish-coalescing: it asks for `??`, which TD-18 bans
decided.typescript/prefer-readonly-parameter-typ: Effect types are not deeply read-only
decided.typescript/require-await: DO-03 bans `Promise.resolve`, so an `async` arrow that awaits nothing is how a callback a dependency types as answering a promise answers a value
decided.unicorn/max-nested-calls: ast-grep nested-call rejects every nested call (064)
decided.unicorn/no-array-callback-reference: a typed callback const states the parameters it reads, and TD-01 gives an owned function no second positional parameter (SC-03)
decided.unicorn/no-null: encoded forms spell absence as null, which an Option schema decodes
decided.unicorn/number-literal-case: the formatter writes a hex literal's digits in lowercase, which the rule refuses
decided.unicorn/prefer-date-now: it asks for `Date.now()`, which EF-17 bans
decided.unicorn/prefer-object-from-entries: it asks for `Object.fromEntries`, where TD-25 uses Effect's `Record`
decided.unicorn/prefer-spread: it asks to spread a string into its characters, which typescript/no-misused-spread refuses
decided.unicorn/prefer-ternary: it asks for the conditional operator, which no-ternary bans (EF-21)
decided.unicorn/prefer-top-level-await: it reads a module-level `Effect.catch`, such as an `Effect.fn`'s trailing one, as a promise chain, and promise-chain keeps every promise awaited (DO-03)
